notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable editorial rubric. docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md were reread before discovery and grading. ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, KEYSTONE CLUB TOKYO, current Yamamoto schedule searches and credible Japanese jazz sources produced no new unrecorded verified Tsuyoshi Yamamoto performance. The broader Tokyo/Kanto pass found one same-day Blue Note Place catch-up and two unrecorded Kenny Barron Trio engagements. Admission and priority were decided separately. Ai Furusato is A: the solo format and her unusually early professional development make the performance worth RADAR attention, but her recurring Tokyo activity and the absence of a scarce one-off context argue for attending if convenient rather than active reprioritization. Both Kenny Barron engagements are A+: Barron is a major living master and this exact trio with Kanoa Mendenhall and Johnathan Blake is a musically strong new configuration worth actively making room for, while six consecutive Tokyo nights across two venues provide ample access and rule out S-level scarcity. The proposed batch shape is A 1 / A+ 2 / S 0 / S+ 0, consistent with the repo's intended broad-base hierarchy and recent A/A+-heavy curated work without using distribution as a quota.

events.subtitle: Piano Colosseum — Birthday Eve solo
events.category: Contemporary Japanese jazz / Piano solo / Emerging artist
events.factual_description: Blue Note Place presents Ai Furusato's Piano Colosseum Live — The Birthday Eve Celebration on Thursday, August 27, 2026 in Ebisu, Tokyo. Doors open at 5:30 PM and the single approximately 70-minute performance starts at 6:30 PM. The venue lists only Furusato on piano. Blue Note Place states that she was born August 28, 2011, entered Berklee College of Music's regular program at age 12 on a Presidential Scholarship, and currently studies there while continuing to perform in Japan. The venue also documents collaborations with musicians including Eric Miyashiro, Masato Honda, Shun Ishiwaka and akiko. Her 2026 Rise EP was released in May and is available on Apple Music.

en.why_it_matters: The point here is the piano with nowhere to hide. Furusato is still only turning fifteen, but she has already spent several years moving between Tokyo sessions and Berklee, and the venue gives her a full solo set rather than another guest spot. That makes the useful question musical rather than biographical: what does her own sense of time, touch and form sound like when there is no rhythm section around her?
en.trip_verdict: Worth keeping on the board for tonight if Tokyo is already in play and the evening is open. I would go for the chance to hear the solo language up close, but I would not displace a rarer master appearance, farewell, premiere or one-off elsewhere in Kanto to make it happen.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí lo interesante es el piano sin dónde esconderse. Furusato apenas cumple quince años, pero ya lleva varios años moviéndose entre sesiones en Tokio y Berklee, y el venue le da un set completo a piano solo en vez de otro cameo. Eso permite hacer la pregunta que importa musicalmente: cómo suenan su propio sentido del tiempo, el toque y la forma cuando no hay sección rítmica alrededor.
es.trip_verdict: La tendría en el tablero para esta noche si Tokio ya está en juego y la tarde queda libre. Sí entraría por la oportunidad de escuchar de cerca su lenguaje solista, pero no desplazaría por esta fecha una aparición más rara de un maestro, una despedida, un estreno o un one-off en otro punto de Kanto.

events.subtitle: Kenny Barron / Kanoa Mendenhall / Johnathan Blake
events.category: Living master / Acoustic piano trio / New trio configuration
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents the Kenny Barron Trio on November 20–22, 2026. On November 20 the sets start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM; on November 21 and 22 they start at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM. The announced trio is Kenny Barron on piano, Kanoa Mendenhall on bass, and Johnathan Blake on drums. The venue frames this as a new trio configuration, pairing Barron's long-running relationship with Blake with Mendenhall on bass. Barron's official itinerary independently confirms the same trio at COTTON CLUB on November 20–22 and then at Blue Note Tokyo on November 23–25. COTTON CLUB lists Barron's 2025 Songbook among the current discography for the engagement.

en.why_it_matters: Barron does not need a gimmick to clear the RADAR threshold; the specific reason is the trio. Johnathan Blake already knows how to let Barron's touch breathe without making the music polite, while Kanoa Mendenhall changes the center of gravity from Barron's more familiar recent bass partnerships. In a small room, that makes this a chance to hear a major living pianist test a fresh balance rather than simply revisit a repertory set.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the COTTON CLUB sets if November overlaps with Tokyo. The trio is strong enough to build an evening around, but the six-night Tokyo run across COTTON CLUB and Blue Note gives enough flexibility that there is no need to chase more than one engagement unless the first set makes you want to go back.

es.why_it_matters: Barron no necesita un gimmick para pasar el filtro del RADAR; la razón concreta es el trío. Johnathan Blake ya sabe cómo dejar respirar el toque de Barron sin volver la música demasiado pulida, mientras Kanoa Mendenhall cambia el centro de gravedad frente a las parejas de bajo más habituales del pianista en años recientes. En una sala pequeña, eso permite escuchar a un maestro vivo probando un equilibrio nuevo y no simplemente repasando repertorio.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets de COTTON CLUB si noviembre coincide con Tokio. El trío alcanza para construir una noche alrededor de él, pero la corrida de seis noches entre COTTON CLUB y Blue Note da suficiente flexibilidad para no perseguir más de una fecha a menos que el primer set te deje con ganas de volver.

en.why_it_matters: The musical case is the same new trio but in a different room after three nights of playing together at COTTON CLUB. By the time Barron, Mendenhall and Blake reach Blue Note, the interest is not novelty alone; it is whether six consecutive Tokyo nights let the trio settle into a deeper shared time and a more elastic sense of form around one of jazz's most refined living pianists.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one Blue Note set if these dates fit better than the COTTON CLUB run. I would treat the two engagements as alternate doors into the same strong opportunity rather than obligations to see both; a genuinely singular one-off elsewhere in Kanto would still take precedence.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento musical es el mismo trío nuevo, pero en otra sala después de tres noches tocando juntos en COTTON CLUB. Para cuando Barron, Mendenhall y Blake lleguen a Blue Note, el interés ya no será sólo la novedad: será escuchar si seis noches consecutivas en Tokio dejan que el trío encuentre un tiempo compartido más profundo y una forma más elástica alrededor de uno de los pianistas vivos más refinados del jazz.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a un set de Blue Note si estas fechas embonan mejor que la corrida de COTTON CLUB. Trataría ambas residencias como dos puertas hacia la misma oportunidad fuerte, no como obligación de ver las dos; un one-off verdaderamente singular en otro punto de Kanto todavía tendría precedencia.
